## Excel

Files ending in `.xlsx` or `.xls` are read with
[readxl](https://readxl.tidyverse.org/). Write Excel files with `-O xlsx` or
by naming the output `.xlsx`.

### Reading

```{bash}
rush run -o sales.xlsx 'data.frame(product = c("Widget", "Gadget", "Doohickey"), q1 = c(100, 250, 75), q2 = c(120, 200, 90), q3 = c(150, 180, 110))'
rush run 'df' sales.xlsx
```

### `--input-sheet`

Select a specific sheet by name or index:

```{bash}
rush run --input-sheet 1 'names(df)' sales.xlsx
```

### Writing

```{bash}
rush run -o summary.xlsx 'df |> dplyr::mutate(total = q1 + q2 + q3)' sales.xlsx
rush run 'df' summary.xlsx
```

### Converting CSV to Excel

```{bash}
rush convert -o penguins.xlsx penguins.csv
rush run 'nrow(df)' penguins.xlsx
```

## ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet)

Files ending in `.ods` are read and written with
[readODS](https://docs.ropensci.org/readODS/):

### Reading

```{bash}
rush run -n 'head(df)' data.ods
```

### Writing

```{bash}
rush run -n -o output.ods 'df' data.csv
```

```{bash}
#| include: false
rm -f sales.xlsx summary.xlsx penguins.xlsx
```
